parent_objective: audit reset-only mild warmup outcome result before new source changes or training
blocked_by: M1405 improved near-boundary candidates but found zero warmup-history-positive outcome rows
supersedes: running another mild-warmup outcome probe without a route decision

public_gates: M1406 must audit M1405 before new source changes or training
M1406 must separate near-boundary progress from self-identification evidence
M1406 must classify reset-only accepted rows and zero warmup-history-positive rows
M1406 must choose config redesign, task API extension, branch synthesis, or another explicit route
M1406 must not train, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, export a training corpus, or change actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not count reset-only rows as self-identification
do not count near-boundary candidates without outcome gaps as self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies M1405 reset-only outcome result and selects the next route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit treats reset-only rows as self-ID evidence
stop if audit ignores preferred near-boundary progress
stop if next route repeats the same source/outcome grid without a new evidence axis
fallback_plan: route to stronger non-oracle warmup stimulus if passive figure-eight is insufficient
route to config redesign if normal margins need tighter outcome pressure
route to branch synthesis if no credible public next route remains

admission_evidence: M1405 found 26 preferred near-boundary candidates but 0 warmup-history-positive rows
M1405 found 2 accepted outcome rows, both reset-hidden high-margin effects from one seed
M1405 did not train, promote, use private holdout, export corpus, or change actor inputs
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: no training or corpus export is admitted from reset-only evidence

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1406 must treat reset-only and action-only effects as insufficient for history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Process audit over M1405 no-training outcome artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If mild-warmup outcome evidence is absent, route to a new source/task design or branch synthesis before training.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, high-fidelity, paper-level result, or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A process audit can determine the next route after M1405 improves near-boundary candidates but finds no warmup-history-positive outcome rows.
success_criteria: audit classifies reset-only accepted rows and zero warmup-history-positive rows
audit chooses a next route without corpus export, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion
failure_criteria: audit treats reset-only rows as self-ID evidence
audit routes directly to training or claim expansion
decision_rule: M1406 passes if it audits M1405 and chooses a redesign or synthesis route before any training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, or actor-input expansion.
